Banner

Banners are full-width messages placed at the top or bottom of a page to communicate important, persistent information.

Top Banner

The default banner is centered at the top of the page and spans the full width.

Our new dashboard is live.
HTML
<div class="zak-banner">
    Our new dashboard is live.
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-link zak-banner-action">Learn more</button>
</div>

Bottom Banner

Stick a banner to the bottom of the viewport for cookie consents or upgrade prompts.

We use cookies to improve your experience.
HTML
/* Sticky bottom position */
.zak-banner-bottom {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
}

<div class="zak-banner zak-banner-bottom">
    We use cookies to improve your experience.
</div>

Banner with Action

Include a prominent call to action using a styled link button.

Get 20% off your first order! Shop now
HTML
<div class="zak-banner">
    Get 20% off your first order!
    <a href="#" class="zak-banner-action" style="font-weight:600;text-decoration:underline;">Shop now</a>
</div>

Banner Dismissible

Add .zak-banner-close so users can dismiss the banner. The close button is positioned at the right edge.

Important: your password will expire in 7 days.
HTML
<div class="zak-banner">
    Important: your password will expire in 7 days.
    <button class="zak-banner-close" aria-label="Dismiss banner">&times;</button>
</div>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-banner-close').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.closest('.zak-banner').remove();
    });
});
</script>

Banner with Icon

Layer an icon with the banner text to reinforce the message.

System maintenance is scheduled for Sunday at 2:00 AM.
HTML
<div class="zak-banner">
    <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 16v-4M12 8h.01"/></svg>
    System maintenance is scheduled for Sunday at 2:00 AM.
</div>

Info / Warning / Danger Banners

Use the semantic modifiers to convey tone.

Info: A new update is available.
Warning: You are running low on storage space.
Danger: Your account has been suspended.
Success: Your changes have been published.
HTML
<div class="zak-banner">Info: A new update is available.</div>
<div class="zak-banner zak-banner-warning">Warning: Storage space is low.</div>
<div class="zak-banner zak-banner-danger">Danger: Your account has been suspended.</div>
<div class="zak-banner zak-banner-success">Success: Your changes have been published.</div>

Banner with Link

A banner can carry a single inline link to related documentation or actions.

Enjoying ZAKUIKit? Read the docs
HTML
<div class="zak-banner">
    Enjoying ZAKUIKit?
    <a href="#" style="color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;font-weight:600;">Read the docs</a>
</div>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-banner           /* Base banner container */
.zak-banner-success    /* Success variant */
.zak-banner-warning    /* Warning variant */
.zak-banner-danger     /* Danger variant */
.zak-banner-action     /* Inline action element */
.zak-banner-close      /* Dismiss button */

/* Add your own position helpers: */
.zak-banner-top {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 900;
}
.zak-banner-bottom {
    position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 900;
}

Accessibility

  • Banners are typically announced as regular content; use role="status" for non-urgent updates or role="alert" for critical ones.
  • Provide an aria-label on the close button so its purpose is clear.
  • When a banner is dismissed via JavaScript, move focus to the banner's triggering element or set focus to the main content.
  • Keep banner copy concise and actionable.
HTML
<div class="zak-banner zak-banner-danger" role="alert">
    Your account is at risk.
    <button class="zak-banner-close" aria-label="Dismiss banner">&times;</button>
</div>
